bias.zh: 偏空 · 受制于 $1,686 下方

read.en: ASML edged up 0.3% on Oct 19 to $1,647.12, fading from $1,681.78 to close near the day's low of $1,646.02. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,662.8), 10-day ($1,725.3) and 30-day ($1,727.8) averages and the 100-day ($1,749.2), and above the rising 200-day ($1,580.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,829.8), and RSI is 38.6.

For a second session the high stalled just under the $1,682–1,686 resistance (Oct 13 low, Oct 16 high), while the close stayed above the $1,619 Sep 3 low. Resistance is $1,663–1,686 (5-day average, Oct 16 high), then $1,725–1,749 (10, 30 and 100-day averages). Support is $1,619, then $1,594 (Oct 15 low) and $1,573–1,580 (Sep 14 low, 200-day). A close below $1,594 would open $1,573.

r.en: 5-day average ($1,662.8) up to the Oct 13 low and Oct 16 high ($1,682–1,686)
